title: Pinarayi flags healthcare crisis in Attappady, seeks ₹5 lakh for each infant death

ai.summary: Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan accused Kerala's UDF government of collapsing Attappady's healthcare system, demanding ₹5 lakh compensation per infant death and urgent intervention for tribal communities.

facts.claim: healthcare system in Attappady has collapsed within just six months of UDF rule
facts.quote: Leader of the Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan has alleged that the healthcare system in Attappady has collapsed within just six months of United Democratic Front (UDF) rule.

facts.claim: suspension of scanning services and shortage of doctors at the hospital
facts.quote: The suspension of scanning services and the shortage of doctors at the hospital have created a serious healthcare crisis, he said.

facts.claim: healthcare workers with sickle cell anaemia were transferred in large numbers
facts.quote: healthcare workers who treated patients with sickle cell anaemia and other serious conditions were transferred in large numbers.

facts.claim: National Health Mission mobile clinics discontinued
facts.quote: National Health Mission (NHM) mobile clinics, laboratories and medical units that once served remote tribal hamlets have been discontinued.

facts.claim: ambulance clinic contracts not renewed due to lack of funds
facts.quote: The contracts for ambulance clinics have also not been renewed, with the authorities citing a lack of funds, he said.

facts.claim: Janani Janma Raksha scheme financial aid unpaid for months
facts.quote: Financial assistance under the Janani Janma Raksha scheme for pregnant women has remained unpaid for months.
Support for patients and their bystanders, along with the monthly assistance of ₹2,000 provided to mothers, has also been stopped, he said.

facts.claim: Community kitchens attached to Anganwadis shut down
facts.quote: Community kitchens attached to Anganwadis have been shut down, while mentor teachers who supported tribal students in schools have been dismissed in large numbers, he said.

facts.claim: demanding ₹5 lakh compensation per infant death
facts.quote: Mr. Vijayan called for ₹5 lakh in compensation for each family that had lost an infant and urged the government to intervene immediately.

ai.background_note: Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan highlighted healthcare failures in Kerala's tribal region Attappady, demanding compensation for infant deaths and government intervention.
